gaps.note: The seven OP Stack chains with ETH gas have had no network unit in cycles 16, 17 and 18. The opcode battery and the targeted set were last run on them before cycle 16, and no release note since then was read. Critic query of web3_clientVersion on 2026-11-25: OP Mainnet op-reth/v2.8.1-72207294, Base reth/v2.5.2-9e380dd/base/v1.5.6, Unichain, Ink and Soneium op-reth/v2.10.0-rc.4-65e80332, Zora conduit-op-reth/v2.5.1-8f0ccac, World Chain world-chain/v2.8.2-9596311. Lagoon reaches OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia about 10 December 2026 and L-352 (high) is still open, so the predeploys 0x4200..0022 to 0x28 and 0x30 will be installed with no network unit watching.

MegaETH had only the sync leak census in cycle 18. Blocks are written by a closed JIT executor (F-118) and L-606, high and open since cycle 9, still has no answer on which executor produces blocks. The endpoint answered mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42 on 2026-11-25 (critic query), a build no cycle has tied to a source revision. Every MegaETH opcode result so far speaks for the replica interpreter or for the stateless validator, not for the producer.

Polygon Salvador (block 98,688,600) and BNB Chain Jenner activate on 8 December 2026, and the next cycle may be the last before them. No tagged bor release carries Salvador: on 2026-11-25 raw.githubusercontent.com returned 404 for params/version.go at bor tags v2.12.0, v2.12.0-beta2 and v2.11.3, 200 at v2.12.0-beta and v2.11.2, and master still sets version 2.11.1 (critic fetch). The endpoints answered bor/f2a2d63e69f6/v2.11.1-private, Geth/v1.8.2-4e1c8247-20261104 and avalanchego/1.15.3 (critic query). No unit in cycle 18 covered these three networks apart from the full-range swaps on Polygon.

The theme-go-toolchain-shapes verifier noted that F-136 lists Elysium without saying whether go1.25.12 lies inside the affected range of Go issue 82839, and F-117 does not say whether the 1.25 branch is affected by issue 81863 at all. Elysium's build names no source commit (nitro/vlocal+unknown-unknown/linux-amd64/go1.25.12, critic query 2026-11-25), so the tree search of seven Go clients does not cover the code it runs.

Ethereum had no network unit in cycle 18. F-117 lists chain 1 because some geth nodes run an affected Go release, while the Ethereum endpoint in networks.json answered reth/v2.11.0-b9abbcc on 2026-11-25 (critic query). The verifier asked that chain 1 be dropped or justified; nobody has named the geth endpoint whose answers support the claim since cycle 17.

op-stack-custom-gas cleared L-245, L-256 and L-343 on the Celo notice that support for op-geth ended on 22 July 2026. The notice says what Celo supports, not which binary the sequencer runs, and forno still routed 34 of 201 pinned batches to op-geth c7ed55b8 this cycle. No block field, builder statement or operator document tying the Celo sequencer to celo-reth was cited.

L-325 stays inconclusive: stablecoin-l1 states that evm2 at 35aa3280 lets a transaction run nested inside another (enter_execution keeps was_running) but did not read crates/zones, crates/consensus or the precompile crates line by line. This is the only place in the 21 clients where a second transaction can start inside a running one, which is exactly what A1 forbids.

HyperEVM's closed validator is now tested through 63,540 Uniswap v3 style swaps of the cycle 18 rest run plus the earlier groups. About 1,010,000 swaps of the two Algebra style factories (0xf77bd082... and 0x5f95e92c...) were left out because their pools answer globalState() and not slot0(). That is the largest body of closed-producer arithmetic on the network and it is unread.

rpc.mainnet.arc.io answers v0.8.6-rc1 at commit 37812c61, which raw.githubusercontent.com does not serve, and arc-rpc.publicnode.com now returns a Cloudflare challenge. The Arc battery and script runs of cycle 18 therefore test an unpublished build on the official endpoint and a published build only on arc.drpc.org.

leads.question: Read the Inbox implementation each rollup actually uses today: the EIP-1967 implementation slot of the Inbox proxy of Robinhood Chain on its parent chain, of Elysium on HyperEVM, and of Arbitrum One after the 2026-10-30 restoration (eth_getStorageAt, eth_getCode, verified source). Does every entry point (sendUnsignedTransaction, sendContractTransaction, the two L1-funded variants, createRetryableTicket, unsafeCreateRetryableTicket, the ToFork variants, sendL2MessageFromOrigin) pass the sender through applyL1ToL2Alias, and does any take a caller-chosen sender?
leads.why: The cycle 18 clearance that an ordinary account cannot post a contract transaction from the PoolManager rests on nitro-contracts main (Inbox.sol:317-325), not on deployed bytecode; the verifier said the Robinhood and Elysium Inboxes were not read. Nitro runs a ContractTx without nonce or code checks, so one Inbox that skips the alias would let anyone move every pooled balance with transfer calls that bypass unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114).

leads.question: At tempo/v1.19.1 (a9d6748) and evm2 35aa3280, list every non-test caller of enter_execution, transact, call_tx and State::committed_copy in the precompile, fee manager, account keychain, T14 batch call and zones crates. For each caller, does the nested run share the outer transaction's transient storage map, start with an empty one, or clear it on return?
leads.why: A nested run that shares the map sees the PoolManager unlocked and the outer caller's deltas (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:21-39); one that clears it drops open deltas before the check at src/PoolManager.sol:112; one that starts empty with committed writes can settle a payment twice (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, 349-364). An ordinary account reaching such a caller would be a critical A1 break.

leads.question: Is any public method on mainnet.megaeth.com (eth_call or eth_estimateGas forwarded to the sequencer, a realtime or mega_ namespace simulation, eth_sendRawTransactionSync dry runs) executed by the sequencer's JIT rather than a replica interpreter, as shown by docs or by a response field? If the producer is the evmone-compiler AOT path, read its MULMOD, SAR, SHL, SIGNEXTEND and CALLDATALOAD handlers for constant-operand specialisations at the five sites cycle 17 tested on Monad (pc 22378 MULMOD by 2^128, 22639 MULMOD by 2^96, 15519 SAR, 16642 SHL, 12232 CALLDATALOAD).
leads.why: L-606 has been open since cycle 9. Every MegaETH vector speaks for an interpreter that does not write blocks (F-118). A compiled MULMOD or SAR that differs on one input changes mulDiv or BalanceDelta unpacking (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24-52, src/types/BalanceDelta.sol:62-64) in blocks only, and an ordinary account could be the first to send that input.

leads.question: Is go1.25.12 inside the affected range of Go issue 82839 (the issue names a variant from go1.24.13) and of issue 81863, according to the issue text and the release-branch.go1.25 history, and which of the two fixes, if any, is in go1.25.12?
leads.why: Settles the verifier's correction to F-136 and F-117 for Elysium, whose build has no published source, so the answer decides whether the tree search can speak for it at all.

leads.question: Which client produces Celo blocks today? Look for a sequencer statement in Celo docs or forum posts after 22 July 2026, the extraData or other client marker of recent blocks, and whether op-geth followers and celo-reth followers have ever reported different block hashes.
leads.why: Three cycle 18 clearances (L-245, L-256, L-343) rest on the end of op-geth support. If the sequencer still ran op-geth, the fee currency debit transient storage difference would apply to block production; the fee currency itself is governance-listed, so the actor would stay governance.

leads.question: Transfer of the cycle 18 Arbitrum finding: on each OP Stack chain, which parties can upgrade OptimismPortal so that TransactionDeposited carries from equal to the PoolManager, does op-reth and op-geth run such a deposit (type 0x7e) without a nonce or code check, and has any chain's portal ever been upgraded in that way?
leads.why: The same pattern as the Arbitrum contract transaction moves every pooled balance without unlock. It is governance level on every chain, but nobody has recorded who holds it on the nine OP Stack networks beyond F-026 for Celo and X Layer ownership.

leads.question: Transfer of L-621: does ruint 1.21.1 (Tempo, Ethereum reth) contain target-specific code (cfg target_arch, intrinsics, inline asm) in mul_mod, add_mod, div_rem, the 2^256-1 fast path or the shifts, and if so do the x86 and non-x86 paths agree on the 8,908 targeted mul_mod vectors? Does any Tempo validator or published reth image run aarch64?
leads.why: L-621 compared x86 and fallback paths only for ruint 1.20.0 subtraction on Arc. The 1.21 rewrite is one month old, sits under every mulDiv (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24), and Tempo has one client.

leads.question: Build a globalState() and tick-tree collector for the two Algebra style factories on HyperEVM and rerun a sample of 20,000 of their about 1,010,000 swaps from parent-block state with the price, amount and fee formulas. Do they reproduce to the unit, and how many reach the 512 bit branch of mulDiv?
leads.why: The closed validator is the only HyperEVM producer, and these swaps are the largest mined body of its arithmetic that no cycle has read. A miscomputed 512 bit product there would also reach FullMath in the PoolManager.
